summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a clarificatory press release dated September 25, 2026, correcting the hard-copy availability statement in its September 23, 2026 release. The filing confirms shareholders may request, free of charge, hard copies of the complete financial statements in PLDT's original 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F via its investor relations email. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; the original Form 20-F is to be read with the August 13, 2026 expected-amendment disclosure. Routine disclosure clarification; no risk-arb angle.
